THE EMPLOYER SEARCH PROCESS

From search brief through
shortlist, interviews and offer management.

  1. 01

    Search brief

    Agree the role blueprint, commercial objectives, territory context and what good evidence looks like.

  2. 02

    Market mapping

    Identify relevant target companies and proven performers across your sector and region.

  3. 03

    Direct approach

    Engage potential passive candidates confidentially and qualify their track record, motivation and expectations.

  4. 04

    Assessment & shortlist

    Assess candidates rigorously and present a focused shortlist with structured interview notes.

  5. 05

    Interviews & offer management

    Coordinate structured interviews, manage offer negotiation, notice-period communication and post-hire onboarding.

EXAMPLE DELIVERABLES · WHAT A BUYER RECEIVES

Concrete outputs at shortlist
and onboarding.

Illustrative examples of the documents prepared during a retained search mandate so hiring directors can assess candidates consistently.

Example deliverable · Shortlist pack

What you receive at shortlist

  • Role blueprint & scorecard: Agreed commercial objectives, P&L ownership and must-have competencies.
  • Market-mapping summary: Anonymised overview of target organisations approached and market compensation feedback.
  • Structured candidate dossiers: Each shortlisted candidate’s commercial track record, motivations, notice period and structured interview notes.
Example deliverable · Onboarding handover

What you receive at offer & onboarding

  • Offer & counter-offer briefing: Package alignment, notice-period communication schedule and start-date risks.
  • 90-day onboarding check-in plan: Agreed 30-, 60- and 90-day commercial milestones reviewed with the hiring director.
  • Optional coaching link: Where agreed separately, transition into 1-to-1 leadership onboarding coaching.

SUPPORT YOUR NEW HIRE AFTER APPOINTMENT

Protect the appointment
with practical onboarding.

Appointing the right person is step one. Where agreed with the client, we connect coaching and business platforms to give new leaders and sales performers immediate traction.

01 / BUSINESS CRM

Accounts & Next Actions

Give your new manager or sales rep instant visibility over account buying history, key contacts and scheduled renewal reviews.

  • Trade customer dossiers and account notes
  • Flag accounts renewing within 30 days
  • Separate from private Personal CRM records
02 / SALES & INTELLIGENCE

Target Accounts & Quote Follow-Up

Focus your new hire on ideal customer profile (ICP) accounts with active trade signals and disciplined quote follow-up.

  • Prioritised Sales Action Queue
  • Follow up open quotes before they slip
  • Human review for all outreach drafts
03 / COMMUNICATIONS

Enquiries & Owned Callbacks

Ensure inbound client enquiries, calls and WhatsApp messages land in a shared team inbox with named callback ownership.

  • AI Voice Receptionist for out-of-hours coverage
  • Unassigned enquiries become owned callbacks
  • Never miss an urgent client quotation request
ONBOARDING COACHING LINK

Manager development & onboarding coaching.

Link your placement to our Operational Performance Accelerator or Leadership Accelerator for 90-day habit coaching. Additional coaching and platform tools are scoped individually with each client based on requirements and are not implied as included with every placement.

ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLE · REGIONAL LEADERSHIP

Regional Operations Director
(Multi-Site Commercial).

Because live client mandates are conducted under bilateral NDAs, this illustrative example shows how a typical search is structured from brief to onboarding.

See how post-appointment Coaching supports new leaders ↗

  • Role

    Regional Operations Director for a multi-site UK B2B commercial profit centre.

  • Challenge

    Replacing a departing leader while protecting key client accounts and lifting quote follow-up discipline.

  • Action

    Defined a commercial brief focused on P&L ownership and client relationships, mapped regional competitors discreetly, and presented a three-candidate shortlist with structured margin-scenario assessments.

  • Outcome (Illustrative)

    Preferred candidate appointed with a 90-day onboarding and leadership coaching plan agreed before start date.
